race.comment: ROYAL FOX (2) has the most dependable recent profile, with a narrow second at Murray Bridge followed by a seventh at Gawler where he was only beaten two and a half lengths after making ground from well back. His 1600m record is sound, Todd Pannell goes back on, and the recent line through HAMNER SPRINGS adds further substance. Can produce a winning run here. HAMNER SPRINGS (5) is better than the wide-run 11th at Gawler suggests and his two wins at the distance keep him right in play. OR AM I (8) backs up quickly after having difficulty getting clear at Gawler and brings a solid mile record with a useful claim. Can measure up with the right run. DODD (11) is third-up after a sound Strathalbyn placing and fair Gawler fifth. Fitter and could be ready to improve out to this distance now.
